findings.evidence: "whose update breaks no peer, ABI or runtime-floor constraint (checked from the resolver output)"
findings.fix: Define a fail-closed branch for checks the resolver cannot establish: inspect package metadata and supported runtimes where available; if compatibility remains unknown, ask per target rather than treating absence of a resolver error as proof.

findings.evidence: The auto-apply and rollback assertions accept "a plan or a report template" and say "no run results are expected".
findings.fix: Add execution-backed cases that verify the actual manifest and lockfile diff, a failed-gate restore, and preservation of unrelated edits; retain the existing plan-only cases.

findings.evidence: The general procedure says to scan and then "Auto-apply each safe cohort", while the description also triggers for audits and finding outdated packages; only the Node scan script explicitly exempts scan-only requests.
findings.fix: Branch on user intent before the update procedure: for audit-only, diagnosis-only, or outdated-list requests, run non-mutating discovery and report without applying changes; enter the write workflow only when updates are requested.

findings.evidence: "Run ... security audit for each cohort. On a failure stop, restore the snapshot of that cohort".
findings.fix: Establish the baseline audit and distinguish scanner execution errors, pre-existing findings, and newly introduced or worsened findings. Stop and report unavailable audits; restore a cohort when its changes cause an unacceptable regression, rather than automatically undoing a vulnerability fix because unrelated findings remain.

findings.evidence: "After updating only approved manifest entries ... Confirm every resolved target matches the approved package-to-target map exactly" conflicts with SKILL.md's auto-apply policy, under which safe targets need no individual approval.
findings.fix: Change the Node workflow to refer to the shown target map, requiring explicit approval only for ask-per-target changes; retain exact diff verification for both auto-applied and approved cohorts.
